description: Traditional charts and tables can be difficult to interpret, especially when dealing with large amounts of data. WAVA Waterfall visual provides a more intuitive and visual way of displaying data, making it easier for users to quickly understand the financial performance of a company. This type of visual is particularly beneficial for business analysts, financial analysts, and executives who need to understand the financial performance of a company, track expenses, and identify areas for improvement. By using the WAVA Waterfall visual, these users can quickly identify the areas where the company is doing well and where it needs improvement. Additionally, they can easily track changes in financial statements and inventory levels over time, which can help them make better-informed decisions.
